info.description: The Cavea server's REST API (`docs/08-server.md` §6). JSON bodies with `snake_case` fields; times are RFC 3339 UTC. Every response carries `Cavea-Request-Id`; a caller may send its own (1 to 64 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`). Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code` (08 §6.4): match on `code`, not on `message`. Lists are `{"data": [..], "next": <cursor or null>}`, oldest first; pass `next` back as `after`. The WebSocket protocol of `GET /v1/public/rt` is 08 §8, which OpenAPI cannot describe.
